QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_61

question.text: CP LLP's E-Diksha project covered 2.5 lakh people across Madhya Pradesh, Jharkhand and Haryana, with Rs. 3.45 Cr spend. The SIA's Outreach-per-Rupee metric is:

answer.text: Rs. 3.45 Cr / 2.5 lakh = Rs. 138 per participant

explanation.text: The Logic: Cost-per-participant = Rs. 3,45,00,000 / 2,50,000 = Rs. 138 per person trained. This is a simple efficiency KPI under SAS-1300 — exactly the investment-efficiency ratio the Chapter 8 E-Diksha case invites. The Trap: Options A, C, D are non-metric combinations. Cross-Exam Context: Same cost-per-beneficiary structure in SAS-1100 and X-A / X-B (Investment Adviser). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Rs. 138 per participant is low — compare against peer financial-literacy programmes (typical range Rs. 200-500). If E-Diksha looks too cheap, dig into whether sessions were truly substantive or just attendance-ticking.
